"""Sparse-matrix variant of the protocol (cells of the training matrix and of every new model's row may be missing).
Per outer fold (whole families held out): standardise each column on the training models that observed it; fit the factor model by masked EM
(rank by inner 5-fold held-out marginal likelihood of the observed cells of the held-out rows, one-SE rule); build the pairwise-covariance and masked
Soft-Impute predictors from the training cells only.  For every held-out model i with enough observed cells: targets T_i = a random 30 % of its OBSERVED cells,
candidate set C_i = the rest of its observed cells (the benchmarks it was actually run on), selectors choose S_i inside C_i, predictors map x_S to x_T.
Reference ('lobo analogue'): the targets predicted from ALL of C_i.  All errors are on the standardised scale of the training columns."""

def fit_fa_masked(Y, mask, r, n_iter=150, tol=1e-4, d_floor=D_FLOOR):
    """Factor analysis by EM with missing cells. Y (M,N) standardised (values at ~mask ignored), mask True = observed. Returns W (N,r), D (N,)."""
    M, N = Y.shape; m = mask.astype(float); Yf = np.where(mask, Y, 0.0)
    cnt = np.maximum(m.T @ m, 1.0); S = (Yf.T @ Yf) / cnt; S = (S + S.T) / 2
    ev, U = np.linalg.eigh(S); idx = np.argsort(ev)[::-1][:r]; sig2 = max(np.sort(ev)[::-1][r:].mean() if r < N else 1e-3, 1e-3)
    W = U[:, idx] * np.sqrt(np.maximum(ev[idx] - sig2, 1e-3)); D = np.maximum(np.diag(S) - (W ** 2).sum(1), d_floor)
    nj = np.maximum(m.sum(0), 1.0); I = np.eye(r); prev = None
    for it in range(n_iter):
        A = I + (m @ _outer(W, D)).reshape(M, r, r); G = np.linalg.inv(A)
        u = (m * Yf / D) @ W; ez = np.einsum('irk,ik->ir', G, u)
        EG = (np.einsum('ir,is->irs', ez, ez) + G).reshape(M, r * r)
        Aj = (m.T @ EG).reshape(N, r, r) + 1e-6 * I; bj = (m * Yf).T @ ez

        res = (m * (Yf - ez @ Wn.T) ** 2).sum(0); mG = (m.T @ G.reshape(M, r * r)).reshape(N, r, r)
